# RS Medical Agency

> RS Medical Agency is a B2B pharmaceutical and healthcare distribution company headquartered in Hassan, Karnataka, India. Established with over 25 years of industry experience, the company connects licensed pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, government institutions, NGOs, and international healthcare distributors with pharmaceutical manufacturers and brands.

## Specialties

- Oncology (Cancer) Medicines: Licensed wholesale distribution of chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, and supportive care oncology products.
- HIV Products: B2B supply of antiretroviral and HIV-related pharmaceutical products to hospitals, government programmes, and NGOs.
- Nephrology Products: Distribution of renal care and nephrology medicines to dialysis centres, hospitals, and healthcare institutions.
- Vaccines: Temperature-controlled vaccine distribution with end-to-end cold-chain monitoring and compliance documentation.

## Trust & Scale

- 30,000+ active SKUs
- 500+ manufacturers and brands
- 99.6%+ order fulfilment rate
- 25+ years of industry experience
- 180+ delivery vehicles
- Coverage across all 31 districts of Karnataka, domestic India, and international markets

## Distributed Brands Include

Sun Pharma, Cipla, Dr. Reddy's, Lupin, Mankind, Zydus, Torrent, Glenmark, Abbott, Alkem, Pfizer, GSK

## Customer Types

Licensed pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, government institutions, NGOs, international healthcare distributors. RS Medical Agency does NOT sell to individual consumers.

## Service Area

All 31 districts of Karnataka: Bagalkot, Ballari, Belagavi, Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru Urban, Bidar, Chamarajanagar, Chikkaballapur, Chikkamagaluru, Chitradurga, Dakshina Kannada, Davanagere, Dharwad, Gadag, Hassan, Haveri, Kalaburagi, Kodagu, Kolar, Koppal, Mandya, Mysuru, Raichur, Ramanagara, Shivamogga, Tumakuru, Udupi, Uttara Kannada, Vijayanagara, Vijayapura, Yadgir. Also serves domestic India and international markets.
